videos.script: Sooner or later you need a file in a guest that is on the host, or the other way round. A driver, a log, a screenshot, a document to test. {{need}} There are three ways. Copy it over the network, as between any two computers. Share a folder, so both sides see the same files. Or copy and paste, through a shared clipboard. {{three}} Shared folders and a shared clipboard are conveniences the hypervisor offers, and both need the guest's agent. They also make a hole in the wall between guest and host, on purpose. {{hole}} You will share two folders with a guest, one it can write and one it can only read. The first write will fail, and why it fails is the most useful thing in this lesson. {{fail}}
